title: FR: Predictive Simulation Settings — some improvements
symptom: The user requests multiple improvements to the Predictive Simulation feature in xDrip, including different colors for different insulin profiles, ability to see active insulin in real time, visibility of basal insulin profile on graph, addition of Apidra insulin profile, and ability to specify different food types with glycemic index. The user emphasizes the importance of seeing each insulin dose separately with its action time.
evidence_quote: After more than 2 years, there has been no activity on this. No developer has shown interest.
